premium.heading: PREMIUM DEER TAGS
premium.prose: Use a 1ST DEER TAG DRAWING APPLICATION to apply for a Premium Deer Tag in the Big Game Drawing. The deadline to apply in the Big Game Drawing for a Premium Deer Tag or Preference Point is June 2. You may use a 2ND DEER TAG DRAWING APPLICATION to apply for Apprentice Hunts. Apprentice Hunts are only available for junior hunting license holders.

citation.source_doc: CDFW Deer Seasons/Tag Classification PDFs (nrm.dfg.ca.gov FileHandler): 2026 Deer Tag Classification Chart.pdf

restricted.heading: RESTRICTED DEER TAGS
restricted.prose: Use a 1ST DEER TAG to purchase a Restricted Deer Tag starting April 15. Use a 2ND DEER TAG to purchase a Restricted Deer Tag starting August 2 if you have a pending Deer Tag Drawing Application or were issued a Premium Deer Tag or Restricted Deer Tag as your 1ST DEER TAG.

citation.source_doc: CDFW Deer Seasons/Tag Classification PDFs (nrm.dfg.ca.gov FileHandler): 2026 Deer Tag Classification Chart.pdf

unrestricted.heading: UNRESTRICTED DEER TAGS
unrestricted.prose: Use a 1ST or 2ND DEER TAG to purchase an Unrestricted Deer Tag starting April 15.

citation.source_doc: CDFW Deer Seasons/Tag Classification PDFs (nrm.dfg.ca.gov FileHandler): 2026 Deer Tag Classification Chart.pdf

drawing_header_verbatim: State of California – Department of Fish and Wildlife REV. 03/16/26 2026 DEER TAG CLASSIFICATION LIST 2026 hunting license, deer tag drawing applications and deer tags will be available for purchase beginning April 15, 2026.

definitions.definition_verbatim: Female deer, fawns of either sex other than spotted fawns, and male deer with an unbranched antler on one or both sides which is not more than three inches in length (T14 CCR §351(b)).
Antlerless deer, or legal bucks that have two or more points in the upper two-thirds of either antler (T14 CCR §351(c)).

A male deer having a branched antler on either side with the branch in the upper two-thirds of the antler. Eyeguards or other bony projections on the lower one-third of the antler shall not be considered as points or branches (T14 CCR §351(a)).
A male deer with unbranched antlers on both sides which are more than 3 inches in length (FGC 200(a)(2)).

spike_rule.headline: A spike buck is not legal on either tag.
spike_rule.explanation: A spike buck has unbranched antlers longer than three inches. That makes it neither a forked-horn buck (which requires a branched antler) nor an antlerless deer (which allows an unbranched antler of not more than three inches). A spike is not a doe — taking one on an antlerless or either-sex tag is not legal.
